content: Second, we evaluate first-line techniques including data augmentation and adversarial training, demonstrating that they offer only marginal benefits here, e.g., a BERT model achieving $90.3$ accuracy on a sentiment classification task, is degraded to $64.1$ by an adversarially-chosen 1-character swap in the sentence, which can only be restored to $69.2$ by adversarial training.
